# CANDIDATE: PULLBACK-HOLD-BULL-TRIGGER_LESS_LAG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** trigger_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The PULLBACK-HOLD-BULL-TRIGGER waits for a pullback followed by a hold period (e.g., N bars of price staying above pullback low) before entering bullish. This hold qualifier adds unnecessary lag, causing late entries on J's anchor days where the move begins immediately after pullback. Removing the hold requirement would capture more of the early move while maintaining edge, as the pullback low break is the primary signal.

## Mechanism

Current design: Identify pullback to support, then wait for H consecutive bars where price holds above pullback low (e.g., closes above low) before entering long.  
Proposed design: Enter at the open of the first bar that closes above the pullback low (i.e., break of pullback low) without requiring additional hold bars. Stop placed below pullback low minus buffer.
